name.en: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (rural housing)

all.manualCheck: Household must be on the SECC 2011 / Awaas+ list after Gram Sabha verification, and not hit any automatic exclusion: motorised 3/4-wheeler, mechanised farm equipment, KCC limit Rs 50,000+, govt employee in household, non-agricultural enterprise, any member earning over Rs 15,000/month, professional tax, irrigated land 2.5 acres+ with equipment or larger holdings.

benefitSummary.en: Rs 1.20 lakh to build a pucca house (Rs 1.30 lakh in hill and north-eastern states), plus 90-95 days of MGNREGA wages for working on your own house and help for a toilet.
benefitSummary.hi: पक्का घर बनाने के लिए 1 लाख 20 हज़ार रुपये। साथ में अपना घर बनाने की मज़दूरी के लिए मनरेगा के 90 से 95 दिन, और शौचालय के लिए मदद।
benefitSummary.mr: पक्के घर बांधण्यासाठी 1 लाख 20 हजार रुपये. सोबत स्वतःचे घर बांधण्याच्या मजुरीसाठी मनरेगाचे 90 ते 95 दिवस, आणि शौचालयासाठी मदत.

documents.en: Proof of land for the house site

applyAt: Gram Panchayat (name must be on the Awaas+ survey list)

applyAtSpoken.hi: अपनी ग्राम पंचायत में, ताकि सर्वे में नाम जुड़ सके
applyAtSpoken.mr: तुमच्या ग्रामपंचायतीत, म्हणजे सर्वेक्षणात नाव नोंदवले जाईल
applyAtSpoken.en: to your Gram Panchayat, so your name gets on the survey

notes: Eligible: houseless households, or those in kutcha houses with 0, 1 or 2 rooms. Destitute, manual scavengers, primitive tribal groups and released bonded labourers are compulsorily included.

Exclusion list revised Dec 2024: 13 criteria cut to 10; two-wheeler, fishing boat, landline and refrigerator removed; income threshold raised from Rs 10,000 to Rs 15,000/month. A Nov 2024 PIB backgrounder still lists refrigerator/landline; the Dec 2024 release is later and is followed here.
A new beneficiary cannot 'apply' on the spot: they must get surveyed (Awaas+ app or the panchayat's survey) and then be approved by the Gram Sabha.
